videoBannerToggleHint: Shows a notice at the top of the gallery when video access isn't allowed
trashToggleHint: When off, deleted photos and videos are deleted permanently instead of going to the trash. Items already in the trash can still be restored or deleted from the trash screen
trashRetentionHint: How long deleted photos and videos stay in the trash. Android removes them automatically after 30 days, so it can't be longer than 30. If you choose a shorter period, the trash screen tells you which items are past it (the app can't delete them without your confirmation). Also applies to items already in the trash.
